articles.title: Storms Could Slow Thanksgiving Travel
articles.summary: Storms on both coasts and recent airline computer problems could delay Thanksgiving trips this week.

articles.title: The Little Gas Station That Welcomed Everyone
articles.summary: The Threatt Filling Station was the only known Black-owned gas station on Route 66, and the family is restoring it for its 100th anniversary.

articles.title: Colombia's Fuzzy 'Water Guardians' Need Help
articles.summary: Volunteers in Colombia are replanting fuzzy frailejón plants that protect the mountain wetlands supplying much of the country's water.
